_comment: Copy to characters/<slug>/spec.json. Fields the user did not state keep these defaults; say so in the report.
name: Courier
_references_note: References for the BASE (body + fused clothing). First image is the front view (required). Add side/back views to reduce hallucinated backs; max 4.
must_have: yellow hooded raincoat with snap buttons
_must_have_note: Only what the BASE must show. Anything listed in parts is checked there instead.

generation.texture_prompt: no glasses, no hat, no drawstrings; plain raincoat collar

_model_type_note: Optional generation.model_type: standard (default: meshy-7.1, remeshed to triangle_budget) or smart-topology (ai_model meshy-t2 up to 15000 faces or meshy-t2.5 up to 30000; native low-poly, one reference only, 15 credits with texture; the driver drops image_enhancement, which returns 400). Visibly lower detail than meshy-7.1 in a side-by-side test: use it only when the user asks for it.
_generation_note: provider meshy|tripo|rodin (only meshy has a driver backend today; tripo/rodin backends are built from their docs when chosen). pose_mode a-pose|t-pose|''. topology triangle|quad (quad for hero close-ups). texture_resolution 2k|4k|8k. geometry_resolution standard|2k|4k (4k single-image only, +5 credits). texture_prompt max 800 chars; use it to keep modular pieces OFF the base and to name a material Meshy misread.

parts.name: bucket_hat
parts.texture_prompt: olive canvas bucket hat, no head inside, hollow

_parts_note: source: procedural (bpy generator in scripts/build_part.py: glasses|drawstrings), meshy (own references, generated with --part NAME), library (file: existing GLB). attach.mode: rigid (100% weight to one bone + socket in UE) or deform (weights copied from the base surface). landmark: eyes|chest|head_top|neck|waist (bone-based when bone names match, else height fraction) with a raycast to the base surface along -Y; offset_m is added after. Parts are built facing -Y at their own origin.

rig._note: Meshy rigs any textured GLB via model_url, so the base may come from another provider.

export._note: true: base SK + one FBX per deform part sharing the skeleton + static FBX per rigid part + sockets.json. false: everything merged into one skeletal FBX.
